alt.en: A large indigo sphere sits in the center of a gray floor. A dashed blue line with one packet runs into it from a small blue cylinder in front, a dotted indigo line links it to a gray camera on the right, and an orange arrow runs from it to a gray globe on the left.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央是一个大的靛蓝色球体。一条带数据块的蓝色虚线从前方的蓝色小圆柱通向球体，右侧灰色相机与球体以靛蓝色点线相连，一条橙色箭头从球体指向左侧的灰色地球仪。

caption.en: Illustration: a model (blue cylinder) is loaded into an attested execution environment (indigo sphere) while a measurement agent (camera) observes the loading, and the environment serves an inference service (globe), as the draft describes. It does not depict a tested deployment or any real system, and it does not show that the binding works as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：按草案的描述，模型（蓝色圆柱）被加载到经远程证明的执行环境（靛蓝色球体）中，度量代理（相机）观察加载过程，该环境再为推理服务（地球仪）提供支持。图中并非经过测试的部署或任何真实系统，也不表明这种绑定能如所述那样起作用。
